[LHYD.10.5.1] Logical emits can match on hydrated facts (their
`corr` is part of the pattern like any other
slot). The logical fact's lifetime is bounded above by the
shortest-lived element in its LHS — if the LHS includes a
hydrated fact whose `retain:` window is 10_min, the logical
fact retracts at hydration TTL. See
[LLOG].
